0.title: Valfuse Node
0.descriptions: A TypeScript toolkit for forms, validation, and localization across React, Vue, Express, and Node.js.
0.details: Valfuse Node brings shared form behavior, validation, localization, and code generation into one modular toolkit. Its core works across frameworks, with dedicated integrations for React, Vue, and Express.

features.0: Shared form state, validation rules, and error handling for web apps.
features.1: Tools for typed translations and generated asset paths.
features.2: React, Vue, and Express integrations built on a shared core.

1.title: localization_gen
1.descriptions: Generates type-safe translations for Flutter apps from modular JSON files.
1.details: This Dart tool turns modular JSON translations into typed Flutter APIs. It supports nested keys, placeholders, plural and context variants, and watch mode, helping teams catch missing translations during development.

2.title: automation_keys_gen
2.descriptions: Keeps Flutter UI test identifiers consistent through CLI checks and generated documentation.
2.details: This Flutter package gives developers and QA teams one naming pattern for UI test keys. A CLI checks keys and generates documentation, making automated tests easier to maintain as an app grows.

3.title: idle_activity_detector
3.descriptions: Detects when users become inactive in Flutter apps, with configurable timeouts and web input support.
3.details: This Flutter package detects activity and inactivity across platforms. On the web, it watches mouse, keyboard, scroll, and touch input. Apps can use it for session warnings or automatic logout.

4.title: Frontend Input Sanitization Study
4.descriptions: Tests safe HTML rendering in React and Flutter against more than 60 XSS attack examples.
4.details: This study compares HTML sanitization in React and Flutter. The repository includes working demos and automated tests using a shared set of more than 60 XSS examples, showing how each platform treats unsafe content.

features.0: React demo with whitelist-based HTML sanitization.
features.1: Flutter demo with a matching sanitization flow.
features.2: Automated test suites using more than 60 XSS payload cases.

5.title: Hono REST API Starter
5.descriptions: A TypeScript API starter with authentication, PostgreSQL access, and build scripts.
5.details: Built with Bun, Hono, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, this starter separates routes, controllers, and services. It includes basic account flows and documents environment setup, database migrations, and release steps.

features.0: Basic login, registration, and logout flows.
features.1: Prisma migrations and PostgreSQL configuration across environments.
features.2: Build and release scripts with Biome checks.

6.title: Firebase Google Sign-In Study
6.descriptions: A Flutter study of Google Sign-In on web and Android, including fallback and error handling.
6.details: This study documents how Google sign-in becomes a Firebase session on Flutter web and Android. It covers web popup and redirect flows, Android sign-in, authentication state, and common setup issues.

features.0: Web popup sign-in with redirect fallback when popups are blocked.
features.1: Android Google Sign-In credential exchange with Firebase Authentication.
features.2: Documentation of auth state, session behavior, and common setup failures.

7.title: Bukit Delight Cafe Ordering System
7.descriptions: A cafe ordering system that groups menu items by sales patterns using k-means.
7.details: This academic web app supports customer orders, cashier operations, and administration. It also uses k-means clustering to group menu items by sales performance.

features.2: K-means clustering to group menu items by sales performance.

8.title: HORA Pro
8.descriptions: A mobile app for employee attendance, location-based check-ins, leave requests, and team chat.
8.details: HORA Pro supports location-based check-in and check-out with selfie verification. Employees can also request leave, chat with their team, and view attendance reports.

9.title: Go REST API Boilerplate
9.descriptions: A Go API starter with authentication, PostgreSQL, Redis sessions, and API documentation.
9.details: This starter provides a modular Go API with JWT authentication, PostgreSQL, Redis-backed sessions, WebSockets, and generated API docs. Docker setup and environment configuration support local development and deployment.
